Tom (AE): Heads-up: Meridian (large payments provider) wants a 3-day POC. Model: helios-34b-tuned (customer weights). Use-cases: convo summarization, embeddings for semantic search + rerank. Key asks: private deploy in their VPC, KMS + optional customer HSM, latency target p95 <=80ms for ~512 token responses, embedding throughput 200qps. Also want an initial cost estimate and a short runbook they can follow.
Rhea (Solutions): Good scope. Pulling a checklist: 1) model variant compatibility (tokenizer + kv layout) 2) quant recommendation (q4_0 vs q2) 3) deployment sizing for 80ms p95 @512 tokens 4) fallback plan (smaller model or distilled variant) 5) eval harness + deterministic prompt set. Do they have a sample query distribution?
Tom (AE): They sent sample traces: median 256 tokens, 90th 880, spikes to 2k during audit runs. Will DM the trace file. They prefer starting in Hosted sandbox, then lift to Private once keys are exchanged.
Kofi (ML): On helios-34b-tuned: tuned LoRA adapters + modified tokenizer merges. First step: run compat scan `rwd-scan --model helios-34b-tuned --checks tokenizer,kv,ops`. Watch for tokenizer mismatch — our embed pipeline expects byte-level normalizer; adapters occasionally alter BOS token. If tokenizer doesn't match we'll provide a token-mapping shim.
Rhea (Solutions): For 80ms p95 at 512 tokens we typically need 2x A100-equivalent GPUs with aggressive batching disabled, or 3x smaller GPUs with prefix KV caching. If tokenizer mapping adds overhead, budget +10-15ms. For embeddings (200 qps) plan a separate dedicated pool or CPU-based embedters depending on dim. What's embedding dim?
Tom (AE): Embedding dim is 1536. They want vector store warm-up and rerank latency <=100ms.
Diego (Infra): Notes: Private deploy prerequisites: VPC peering details, customer KMS ARN (or HSM endpoint), service account role for access. For on-prem air-gapped option we need a 2-week setup and signed NDA addendum. Network ACL: allow control-plane from our ops CIDR. For GPU sizing I'll draft a proposed infra plan.
Anya (Security): Security checklist: SOC2 + penetration test report requested, KMS policy must include cross-account decrypt to our role, and we need to know retention requirements for logs. If they insist on HSM, add 3 weeks and legal changes. Also ask for their DLP rules for embeddings (PII scrubbing).
Lina (Finance): Quick cost sketch: Hosted sandbox (ephemeral) -> nominal, Private reserved pool (2xA100 equiv) -> ~$12k/mo committed baseline; adding embedding pool (1xV100 equiv) -> +$3k/mo. Onboarding one-time infra/setup fee ~$6k if HSM requested. I'll convert to detailed quote once Diego gives GPU types.
Kofi (ML): I'll kick off the scan now. If tokenizer check fails, I can run our token-shim tool: `rwd-token-shim --source helios-34b-tuned --map meridian-tokenmap.json` and then `rwd-compat-build`. Expect ~60-90m. If peak KV memory >48GB at 512 tokens we should push q4_0; q2 risky for quality.
Rhea (Solutions): Proposed POC success criteria: 1) p95 latency <=80ms for 512 tokens under simulated traffic, 2) embedding recall@10 >= baseline-2%, 3) rerank latency <=100ms, 4) no PII leakage on a seeded test-suite. I'll assemble the harness.
Diego (Infra): Small infra snippet for customer's networking team to paste into their runbook:
```
# Provide these to Redwood
- VPC ID: vpc-xxxx
- Allowed CIDRs: 34.120.0.0/16, 52.18.0.0/16
- KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
- Service role ARN: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-poc
```
Also asking for EIP reservation window if they want static endpoints.
Tom (AE): Meridian also asked: can we start with Hosted but force traffic to their VPC for data ingress? They want quick start.
Anya (Security): Hybrid approach ok: use Hosted for model iteration with synthetic data, then flip to Private once keys are in place. But no real customer data should be sent to Hosted. Need attestations.
Kofi (ML): Scan done: tokenizer merges differ (minor) and one fused kernel missing for a custom attention op. I can run a compatibility build that rewrites the attention as supported ops — quality should be identical. Memory at 512 tokens: ~42GB KV peak. For safety recommend q4_0 to reduce to ~30GB if they want 2-GPU footprint.
Lina (Finance): With q4_0 option our monthly guidance: reserved 2-GPU pool (q4_0) -> ~$9k/mo. Add embedding pool + network egress estimate. I'll follow up with a PDF quote.
Rhea (Solutions): Next steps: 1) Tom to upload weights to secure bucket + provide tokenized sample traces, 2) Diego to produce Private-runbook + exact GPU SKU recommendation, 3) Kofi to attach compat report + recommended quant profile, 4) Anya to pre-fill security vendor questionnaire and flag HSM clause, 5) Lina to draft quote.
Tom (AE): Uploading weights to s3://redwood-secure/meridian/helios-34b-weights.tar.gpg now. I'll DM the access link.
ci-bot: Started job 1759876550: model-compat-scan on runner-21.
Rhea (Solutions): Adding a curl example for their ops team to smoke test after we provision the endpoint:
```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"helios-34b-tuned-compat","input":"Find payments flagged for review"}'
```
Diego (Infra): I'll include a firm reserved pricing table once we pick exact GPU SKUs. Expect a formal quote tomorrow.
Tom (AE): Thanks team — will reopen when Meridian confirms upload + legal okayed the basic NDA. :raised_hands:
